briefdescription.para: Makes a PE set out of a PE list. A PE list is an ordered list of PEs a PE set is a triad (start,log2stride,size) for SHMEM, an a communicator for MPI if stride is non-uniform or not a power of 2, will return error (not required for MPI but enforced for uniformity)
A very basic error handler uses ABORT and FLUSH calls, may need to use cpp to rename.
This is to check if current PE's outstanding puts are complete but we can't use shmem_fence because we are actually waiting for a remote PE to complete its get.
Utility routines for parallelization with MPI.
